messages:
Mira_Sales: Hey team — Scallop wants a Private deployment POC. They're strict about egress control and want source IP preserved for allowlists. Looking for guidance: VPC Peering vs PrivateLink, firewall rules we should ask for, and rough pricing delta. Can we do a quick handoff?
Sam_NetOps: For preserve-src-ip: with PrivateLink the traffic originates from our ENIs in the customer's VPC, so source will be our ENI. We don't preserve client src unless they use a direct proxy on-prem. TL;DR: if they need client IP, ask for an on-prem proxy or load balancer that forwards X-Forwarded-For.
Raj_SE: Adding - PrivateLink is better for cross-account & no routing changes. Peering is simpler if both accounts are in same org and you want native routing. PrivateLink requires interface ENIs and ENI IPs in consumer subnets.
Mira_Sales: @Sam_NetOps what's the typical firewall allowlist we request for Private deployments? just 443 to our ENI IPs?
Sam_NetOps: Yes 443 outbound to our ENI IPs (or to the interface endpoint DNS) + ephemeral for health checks. Example minimal:
```
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to 10.1.12.0/26 (our ENI range)
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to *.redwood-inference.internal (if they use FQDN allowlists)
- Allow ICMP for path MTU if they want diagnostics
```
Raj_SE: Also ask for: DNS resolution from the VPC to our endpoint, and NTP if they block external time sources. If they run TLS inspection, confirm SNI passthrough or cert pinning.
Ella_Security: From security/questions: Scallop asked about key management and audit logs. We can provide:
- SOC2 report (redacted)
- Network diagrams for the Private deployment
- KMS integration options (customer-managed keys via BYOK)
I'll attach the standard answers doc after the call. :white_check_mark: 
DevDeployBot: POC ticket created: POC-2026-9001 assigned to sam_netops, raj_se; scheduled kickoff 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC.
Mira_Sales: Pricing ask: customer wants delta vs hosted. Raj/Sam ballpark?
Sam_NetOps: Ballpark: PrivateLink infra cost for us is slightly higher => pass-through: data processing + cross-AZ ENI costs. For a small POC expect ~$800-2,000/mo depending on throughput. Dedicated/reserved capacity is separate and can be quoted.
Raj_SE: Also factor engineering support + onboarding hours (usually 8-16h) and if they require static EIPs (for whitelists) there's a small monthly cost per EIP.
Mira_Sales: OK. Can someone paste a quick snippet we can put in the security questionnaire about PrivateLink data flow?
Ella_Security: Sure — use this:
```
All customer inference requests originate inside the customer's VPC and are routed to Redwood's interface endpoints (AWS PrivateLink). TLS terminates at our inference nodes; we support customer-managed keys for persisted data and provide audit logs for inference requests. No customer data is retained beyond configured retention windows unless otherwise contracted.
```
Sam_NetOps: One enterprise blocker we've seen: customers that require source-IP preservation for downstream IDS. Short workaround: have them deploy a small NAT/forward proxy in their VPC that forwards client IP in X-Forwarded-For. We'll document an example container.
Mira_Sales: Perfect. Let's do the kickoff then. Action items: sam -> final firewall snippet, raj -> quote estimate + EIP cost, ella -> attach SOC2/KMS snippets. I'll loop in Scallop now. :thumbsup: 
Scallop_Contact: thanks — appreciate the checklist. We'll review and respond by EOD.
Sam_NetOps: Sending firewall snippet now in thread.
Sam_NetOps: ```
# Firewall allowlist (consumer VPC)
Outbound:
  - TCP 443 to 10.1.12.0/28 (Redwood PrivateLink ENIs)
  - TCP 443 to *.redwood-inference.example (if allowlist by FQDN)
  - ICMP echo (optional) for troubleshooting
Notes: Confirm ENI CIDR from account handoff; if using EIP-based egress request explicit EIP addrs.
```
Mira_Sales: thanks all. I'll schedule kick off and attach the ops checklist in calendar invite.
Ella_Security: I'll DM the questionnaire answers and attach the SOC2 redacted copy.
Raj_SE: I'll put together the pricing line item and send a short quote.
Mira_Sales: great — closing loop. :rocket:
